info.name: SWAPI - Star Wars Films People API

params.name: search
params.description: Case-insensitive partial match against the resource's main name/title field.

params.name: page
params.description: One-based page number for paginated list responses (10 items per page).

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of characters from the Star Wars universe.

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric SWAPI identifier for the resource.

items.docs: Returns a single Star Wars character by its numeric SWAPI id.
